portedFromUpstream: DimAgent provider: `dim usage --json` with a 20-second deadline and a 256 KB ceiling, subscription bucket, 5h/1d/7d token windows, top-ups kept as separate windows and the web-search allowance
MiniMax and MiniMax CN merged into one provider with an international/mainland site setting; the retired key file is renamed and its settings folded at startup
Antigravity group rings (up to three, each switchable, more groups keep the whole account) and the Gemini.app `agy` source behind an auto/CLI/desktop choice sharing the desktop reply mapping
Xiaomi pay-as-you-go balance ring with a low-balance note
Extension PNG icons: manifest `icon`, scoped-path and PNG validation (absolute paths, `..`, non-files, empty files and APNG rejected), drawn in the extension's own colours with fallbacks in the UI
ego lite browser profile roots for console logins, plus the Windows browser-permission wording
Console renewal failures classified into eight kinds; only a refused credential asks for a new login and the rest keep the last reading with a note
Z.ai/Zhipu history cached per site and per key fingerprint, so a site switch discards the old series and a new key re-reads the history
Command Code priced through models.dev and given a working mark from `~/.commandcode/projects` (messages only, `.checkpoints.jsonl` ignored)
Usage chart drawn from the first day of records and still shown for a single-day range
Devin card folds usage that arrived through Oh My Pi without double counting
Detail cards scroll with their title held, settings groups and rows carry a small symbol, and the About pane has Star/afdian entries with a single request after a fortnight of real use
limitations: Not full Pulse 1.13.0 parity; real-account and real-machine acceptance remain open and are listed in docs/release-progress.json
Extension PNG icons are not drawn in the tray, which keeps the built-in monochrome icon
Icons are added to settings group titles and rows but not to action buttons
Proxy mode 使用代理 still relies on the manual proxy; the original's "no network until the system proxy is on" mode is not implemented
Localization is out of scope: the interface is Chinese only
externalLimitations: 44 status pages verified against fixtures only; gemini-cli, command-code and hugging-face timed out from this network
Exchange-rate endpoint, offline and 429 behaviour not exercised against the real service
Anonymous GitHub backup API rate limited; live fallback not accepted
Real Harness read-only integrity check failed because source logs changed during its scan
Raycast and Sketchybar status-line helpers are macOS-only; the developer kit exports PowerShell and POSIX helpers with the same read-only commands
